stele.inscription.v:
THE CONSTITUTION OF VOLUMETRIC SOVEREIGNTY
------------------------------------------
rho_source != V_transport != D_medium
D_medium   != sigma_t     != sigma_s != C_v

Here in Borealis Sanctuary, light does not meet flat surfaces or fake alpha meshes.
Participating medium is continuous mathematical reality:
1. volume.density.ast    D(p,t)        -> scalar existence & spatial shape
2. volume.extinction.ast sigma_t(p,t)  -> scalar optical thickness & transmittance
3. volume.scattering.ast sigma_s(p,t)  -> scalar scattering albedo & radiance
4. volume.chroma.ast     C_v(p,t)      -> vec3 spectral medium color

Proceed down the promenade to witness the sovereignty of each channel.

displayName.v: Stele I: Volumetric V1 Extinction Sovereignty

stele.inscription.v:
STATION I: V1 EXTINCTION SOVEREIGNTY (D != sigma_t)
---------------------------------------------------
Behold the two floating clouds flanking this dais:
- Left Cloud:  volume.extinction.ast = 0.16 (Airy / Transmitting)
- Right Cloud: volume.extinction.ast = 2.85 (Dense / Attenuating)

Their density mathematics D(p,t) are BYTE-IDENTICAL. Both clouds have the
exact same geometric bounds, noise folds, and mass of medium.

Look through them to the golden beacons placed behind at Z=35:
The Left Beacon shines through the airy cloud with high transmittance (T ~ 0.75).
The Right Beacon is severely darkened and extinguished (T ~ 0.02).
Extinction governs optical attenuation independently from spatial density.

displayName.v: Stele II: Volumetric V2 Scattering & Chroma Sovereignty

stele.inscription.v:
STATION II: V2 SCATTERING & CHROMA SOVEREIGNTY (sigma_s & C_v)
--------------------------------------------------------------
Observe the two serpentine clouds flanking this dais:
- Left Cloud:  sigma_s = 1.25, C_v = vec3(0.08, 0.98, 0.68) (Emerald/Cyan)
- Right Cloud: sigma_s = 0.28, C_v = vec3(0.78, 0.16, 0.92) (Violet/Magenta)

Both clouds share the EXACT SAME density D(p,t) AND the EXACT SAME
extinction sigma_t(p,t) = 0.65.

Because sigma_t is identical, background quartz needles at Z=70 attenuate
at the exact same physical rate e^(-sigma_t * ds) through both media.
The radiant emerald surge versus mystical violet glow is entirely authored
by volume.scattering.ast and volume.chroma.ast without modifying D or sigma_t.

displayName.v: Stele III: The Celestial Aurora Veil (Hero V1+V2 Synthesis)

stele.inscription.v:
STATION III: THE CELESTIAL AURORA VEIL
--------------------------------------
Above you rises the Hero Aurora Curtain (span: 44m wide, 24m tall, 20m deep).
It unites all four authored participating-medium channels into living harmony:

1. D(p,t): Thin undulating ribbon sheet (z_fold = 2.6*sin(0.18*x) + 1.2*cos(0.35*x)),
   striated by vertical ray harmonic waves and Perlin noise turbulence,
   forming organic folds, wisps, and transparent gaps.
2. sigma_t(p,t): Vertical altitude gradient (0.25 -> 0.80) that attenuates deeply
   at the rooted base while fading to delicate gossamer transparency at the crest.
3. sigma_s(p,t): Harmonic wave patches (0.35 -> 1.10) producing shimmering folds
   where auroral rays catch intense scattering radiance.
4. C_v(p,t): Continuous spectral shift from lower oxygen green (557.7 nm) to
   mid turquoise/cyan, upper nitrogen violet, and high-altitude crimson fringes (630 nm).

Gaze past the curtain to see the 5 Celestial Needles at Z=125 truncated by opaque scene depth.
